months.7: Hot days make the shaded forest ridges and the Hagenbachklamm gorge the most comfortable places to walk, so start early.
months.8: Summer heat continues, and the beech-shaded trails of the Vienna Woods are the best refuge on hot afternoons.

months.1: Cool, dry days suit the Aravalli trails near Kumbhalgarh and the climb to Guru Shikhar at Mount Abu, though winter fog and smog can haze the plains.
months.12: Cool, dry days are good for treks at Kumbhalgarh and the Guru Shikhar climb, though winter fog and smog often haze the plains.

months.8: The alpine trails off Tioga Road are at their best, offering warm days and clear paths. Valley waterfalls dry to a trickle, making the high country the main draw. Wildfire smoke is possible in late summer.
months.9: Cooler temperatures and clear trails make this an excellent month for long day hikes. The Half Dome cables are open, and the high-country routes are free of snow and insects. Wildfire smoke can still drift in.

months.8: This is the peak month for high-altitude trekking. All backcountry passes are clear of snow, making it the best time to hike the High Sierra Trail or explore the deep glacial valleys of Kings Canyon. Wildfire smoke is possible in late summer.
months.9: Excellent hiking continues with cooler temperatures and clear skies. The high alpine routes remain open and free of snow, offering perfect conditions for multi-day treks before the autumn storms arrive. Wildfire smoke can still drift in.
